title: Pambara Kannale
desc: Arumugam, a poor man, comes to Ooty for a job and falls in love with Pooja. However, Pooja is engaged to marry Gautam, an evil and deceptive person.

title: Vaanmathi
desc: Krishna, a young man, comes from a middle-class family but falls in love with a rich girl. Things take a turn when the girl's father opposes their union.

title: Vanna Thamizh Pattu
desc: Impressed by his voice, Muthumanikkam, a village head, hires Bhoopathy as his servant. However, things become complicated when it is revealed that he is already married to Bhuvana, his daughter.

title: Puthu Vasantham
desc: Under certain circumstances, Gowri ends up living with four boys who are singers. But when her fiancé learns of this, Sithara sets out to prove that the boys are nothing more than friends.

title: Vennila Kabadi Kuzhu 2
desc: When a young man uncovers the truth about his father's passion for kabaddi, he sets out to become a kabaddi player and fulfill his father's unrealised ambition in the sport.
